name: B10-0221/2025 (S&D) – Immediate risk of further repression by Lukashenka’s regime in Belarus - threats from the Investigative Committee
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the immediate risk of further repression by Lukashenka’s regime in Belarus – threats from the Investigative Committee
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its position and making requests. It asks for an immediate end to the repression of the people of Belarus and for all political prisoners to be released without conditions. It calls on countries not to send Belarusian citizens who fled back home, where they could be persecuted. It also asks the European Union and its member states to raise the misuse of international arrest warrants with Interpol.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. These are requests and statements of concern, not new rules.
- **Who it affects:** Belarusians facing repression at home and abroad, and countries asked not to send them back.
- **What happens next:** The text goes to the European Commission, the Council, member state governments and others named in it.
